product.name: Network as a Service
product.description: Managed network infrastructure and connectivity delivered as a service for organizations requiring scalable links across sites, regions, and access technologies.

product.name: Satellite Connectivity Services
product.description: GEO, MEO, and LEO satellite connectivity for internet access, enterprise networks, cellular backhaul, rural connectivity, media, and IoT applications.

product.name: Teleport Services
product.description: Satellite and IP teleport services including video and audio uplink, downlink, turn-around, playout, data-center handoff, and global IP connectivity.

product.name: Enterprise Connectivity Services
product.description: Business connectivity services including MPLS, virtual network operation, internet access, and integrated terrestrial or satellite links for distributed organizations.

product.name: Rural Connectivity
product.description: Connectivity deployments for underserved and remote communities using satellite and other communications technologies to provide internet and digital access.

product.name: Broadcasting Services
product.description: Broadcast contribution, distribution, OTT, and video-neighborhood services for delivering television, radio, and streaming content to audiences.
